caption: The drawing depicts three square-shaped fabric swatches arranged diagonally in a zigzag pattern from the upper left to the lower right against a cream-colored background. The top swatch is comprised of a small check pattern in dark brown and lighter brown hues. The middle swatch is placed partially below and to the right of the top swatch, featuring a red base with black plaid stripes forming a classic tartan pattern. The bottom swatch overlaps partially with the middle swatch and is characterized by a blue and dark gray checkered pattern. All three swatches have soft, slightly frayed edges, and their arrangement appears evenly spaced. There is a small printed text "J. QUINIA" in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Zoar Cloth Samples
